post_content: This 9 day gorilla and chimpanzee trekking safari crosses Uganda from Ziwa Rhino Sanctuary and Murchison Falls to Kibale, Queen Elizabeth National Park and Bwindi for chimpanzee and mountain gorilla treks.
overview:
This 9 day gorilla and chimpanzee trekking safari is a private Uganda road trip from Entebbe. You spend 1 night in Kampala, 2 nights in Murchison Falls, 2 nights in Kibale, 1 night in Queen Elizabeth National Park and 2 nights in Bwindi, with rhino tracking, chimpanzee and gorilla treks. Prices start from USD 5,474 per adult, and it suits travellers who want primates and savannah wildlife in one trip.

The safari uses a pop-up roof extended Land Cruiser with an English-speaking driver guide and full-board lodges, and works well for couples, friends and older children who can manage long forest hikes.

Why choose a 9 day gorilla and chimpanzee trekking safari?

Uganda is one of the few countries where you can track mountain gorillas, chimpanzees and white rhinos on foot in a single trip. This itinerary links Ziwa Rhino Sanctuary, Murchison Falls, Kibale, Queen Elizabeth and Bwindi Impenetrable National Park, so you see the Nile, forest primates and savannah game in nine days.

  • Primates: chimpanzee trekking in Kibale and gorilla trekking in Bwindi.
  • Big game: rhinos at Ziwa and game drives in Murchison Falls and Queen Elizabeth.
  • Water: a Victoria Nile boat cruise and a Kazinga Channel boat cruise.

What to expect on the 9 day gorilla and chimpanzee trekking safari

Day 1 begins at Entebbe International Airport with a transfer to Kampala Serena Hotel. On day 2 you drive about 6 to 7 hours north, tracking white rhinos on foot at Ziwa Rhino Sanctuary and visiting the Top of the Falls before Pakuba Safari Lodge. Day 3 has a sunrise game drive and an afternoon boat cruise on the Victoria Nile to the base of Murchison Falls.

On day 4 you drive about 5 to 6 hours to Primate Lodge Kibale. Day 5 is chimpanzee trekking in Kibale National Park (2 to 4 hours, with one hour with the chimps), then the Bigodi Wetland nature walk. Day 6 is a drive of about 2 to 3 hours to Elephant Plains Lodge and a Kazinga Channel boat cruise in Queen Elizabeth National Park.

Day 7 starts with a game drive on the Kasenyi Plains, then a drive of about 5 to 6 hours to Four Gorilla Lodge in Bwindi. Day 8 is gorilla trekking (2 to 8 hours) and a Batwa community visit. On day 9 you drive about 10 to 11 hours back to Kampala and Entebbe for your flight or hotel.

Is 9 days enough for gorillas and chimpanzees in Uganda?

Nine days is enough for one gorilla trek and one chimpanzee trek, plus Murchison Falls and Queen Elizabeth, but it includes long drives, the longest about 10 to 11 hours on the last day. Read our chimpanzee trekking in Kibale guide and our Bwindi gorilla trekking guide to plan the treks, and compare parks in the best national parks to visit in Uganda.

What is included in the 9 day gorilla and chimpanzee trekking safari?

The price includes a pop-up roof extended Land Cruiser, an English-speaking driver guide, fuel and all ground transport, Murchison Falls park fees, the game drive and Nile boat cruise, chimpanzee trekking, the Bigodi Wetland walk, full-board accommodation, en-route lunches, drinking water, park entrance fees for clients, vehicle and guide, a ranger during game drives, all taxes and airport transfers.

Not included are visas, passports, domestic and international flights, beers and wines, and personal items. faq.q: When is the best time for the 9 day gorilla and chimpanzee trekking safari?
faq.a: The 9 day gorilla and chimpanzee trekking safari runs all year. The drier months, usually June to September and December to February, are the most popular because forest trails in Kibale and Bwindi are firmer and game viewing in Murchison Falls and Queen Elizabeth is easier. Gorilla permits sell out in these months, so book early.

faq.q: What is included in the 9 day gorilla and chimpanzee trekking safari?
faq.a: The 9 day gorilla and chimpanzee trekking safari includes a pop-up roof Land Cruiser with a driver guide, fuel, full-board accommodation, Murchison Falls park fees, the game drive and Nile boat cruise, chimpanzee trekking, the Bigodi Wetland walk, drinking water, taxes and airport transfers. Visas, flights, drinks and personal items are extra; we confirm the gorilla permit in your quote.

faq.q: Where do you stay on the 9 day gorilla and chimpanzee trekking safari?
faq.a: On the 9 day gorilla and chimpanzee trekking safari you stay at Kampala Serena Hotel (1 night), Pakuba Safari Lodge in Murchison Falls (2 nights), Primate Lodge Kibale (2 nights), Elephant Plains Lodge in Queen Elizabeth (1 night) and Four Gorilla Lodge in Bwindi (2 nights). Luxury, mid-range and budget options can be arranged.

faq.q: Is the 9 day gorilla and chimpanzee trekking safari suitable for families?
faq.a: The 9 day gorilla and chimpanzee trekking safari suits families with older children. Uganda Wildlife Authority allows gorilla trekking from age 15 and chimpanzee trekking from about age 12. The gorilla trek can take 2 to 8 hours on steep, muddy trails, and some drives take 10 to 11 hours, so tell us the ages in your group.
